title: Key map contract
description: The C-x key map that the TUI and the Companion share. Press C-x, then a group key, then a verb key. Each client binds the verbs that it can run.

group.description: One C-x group, in band order. x-vis-key is the plain key after C-x that opens it.

oneOf.title: Session
oneOf.description: Switch, start, fork and file sessions

oneOf.title: Group
oneOf.description: Rename, colour, archive and delete groups

oneOf.title: Model
oneOf.description: Model, reasoning and answer length

oneOf.title: View
oneOf.description: Search, folds, Zen mode and panels

oneOf.title: Attachments
oneOf.description: Attach files and look at pictures

oneOf.title: Voice
oneOf.description: Voice input and spoken answers

oneOf.title: Queue
oneOf.description: Send or edit queued messages

oneOf.title: Agents
oneOf.description: Open a subagent, or go back to its parent

oneOf.title: Extensions
oneOf.description: Keys that extensions add

verb.description: One app verb in kebab case, in band order. x-vis-key is its plain key inside x-vis-group, or after C-x when it has no group.

oneOf.title: help
oneOf.description: Show every key binding

oneOf.title: new session
oneOf.description: Start an empty session

oneOf.title: switch session
oneOf.description: Open another session

oneOf.title: delete session
oneOf.description: Delete this session after you confirm
oneOf.$comment: C-x s Backspace and C-x s Delete also delete (input/resolve-prefix-key).

oneOf.title: archive session
oneOf.description: Archive this session, or restore it

oneOf.title: fork session
oneOf.description: Copy this session into a new one

oneOf.title: fork at turn
oneOf.description: Copy this session up to a turn that you choose

oneOf.title: move to group
oneOf.description: File this session under a project group
oneOf.$comment: BLO-167: file the session under one of its project's groups.

oneOf.title: session metrics
oneOf.description: Show the token use and budgets of this session

oneOf.title: new group
oneOf.description: Create a group in this session's project
oneOf.$comment: The Group verbs act on the group that holds the current session.

oneOf.title: rename group
oneOf.description: Rename this session's group

oneOf.title: group colour
oneOf.description: Change the colour of this session's group

oneOf.title: group settings
oneOf.description: Open the settings of this session's group

oneOf.title: archive group
oneOf.description: Archive this session's group, or restore it

oneOf.title: delete group
oneOf.description: Delete this session's group after you confirm

oneOf.title: next model
oneOf.description: Use the next configured model

oneOf.title: choose model
oneOf.description: Choose a model from a list

oneOf.title: reasoning
oneOf.description: Set the reasoning effort

oneOf.title: fast mode
oneOf.description: Turn Codex fast mode on or off
oneOf.$comment: Fast mode acts only on OpenAI Codex, so other sessions do not see it (#333).

oneOf.title: length
oneOf.description: Make answers shorter or longer

oneOf.title: thinking summary
oneOf.description: Show or hide the summary of model thinking

oneOf.title: providers
oneOf.description: Add model providers and sign in

oneOf.title: search
oneOf.description: Find text in this conversation

oneOf.title: jump to bottom
oneOf.description: Go to the newest message

oneOf.title: label folds
oneOf.description: Put a key on each fold, then press it to jump
oneOf.$comment: z is the vim fold prefix: the jump-label overlay toggles folds.

oneOf.title: zen mode
oneOf.description: Show only the transcript and the prompt
oneOf.$comment: Zen mode shows only the transcript and the prompt.

oneOf.title: side panel
oneOf.description: Show or hide the side panel view

oneOf.title: session apps
oneOf.description: Pick an app of this session and open it

oneOf.title: global apps
oneOf.description: Pick an app that runs outside the sessions and open it

oneOf.title: project sidebar
oneOf.description: Show or hide the project sidebar

oneOf.title: agent details
oneOf.description: Show or hide the subagent details

oneOf.title: attach file
oneOf.description: Add files to the next message

oneOf.title: inspect attachments
oneOf.description: List, preview and remove attachments

oneOf.title: view images
oneOf.description: Show the session pictures in the terminal
oneOf.$comment: Only a graphical terminal can show the image viewer.

oneOf.title: open picture
oneOf.description: Open the newest picture in the system viewer
oneOf.$comment: The system viewer works on every terminal.

oneOf.title: record
oneOf.description: Start or stop voice input

oneOf.title: conversation
oneOf.description: Speak the answers of this conversation
oneOf.$comment: The conversation mode speaks the answers of this conversation, and only this one.

oneOf.title: send all now
oneOf.description: Give every queued message to the running turn
oneOf.$comment: Mark every queued message for the running turn's next step.

oneOf.title: edit queued
oneOf.description: Edit, move or remove queued messages
oneOf.$comment: The keys act on the Queued block until Esc (input/queue-focus-event).

oneOf.title: agent team
oneOf.description: List the subagents, then open one
oneOf.$comment: C-x t 1-9 opens that dock row (input/resolve-group-key).

oneOf.title: back to parent
oneOf.description: Open the session that started this subagent

show_when.description: The context in which a band lists a verb. The palette and help list every verb.
